name: boundary/projector component
statement: Dq_boundary_projector measures hidden vertical drift of the local collar, normals, caps, orientations, worldtube and boundary projectors, not physical radiation itself.
guard: open/radiative flux is a residual, not part of the adopted zero

name: fixed compact collar q-basicity
statement: If W_loc, Sigma_in/out, C_side, C_rad, normals, orientations and Pi_loc are selected before variation as q-basic readout data, then delta_v boundary_projector=0.
guard: fails if the source worldtube/projector is varied by hidden fields

name: no-flux support separation
statement: If supp(T_local) is inside W_loc and n_mu T_cross^{mu nu} tau_nu vanishes on C_side and sector interfaces, the local projector has no hidden source-crossing term.
guard: fails for source crossing, open-memory/cosmology pullback or moving apparatus boundaries

name: fixed collar C1 silence
statement: A fixed collar/projector with fixed normals and orientations has zero local derivative on the compact test window, so the C1 row vanishes in the standard branch.
guard: fails for boundary-layer motion or time-dependent readout projectors

name: open boundary fallback
statement: If F_rad, R_source_crossing, R_corner_edge, R_memory_pullback or Delta_projector is nonzero, retain epsilon_boundary_projector <= |R_boundary_projector|/M_H_ref with no cancellation against other Dq rows.
guard: radiation and moving boundaries remain physical scored residuals
